title: Elastic Beanstalk and ECS Deployment
description: Deploy ASP.NET Core apps to AWS Elastic Beanstalk and ECS using C# and deployment pipelines.
longDescription: Learn how to deploy an ASP.NET Core web app to AWS using Elastic Beanstalk for traditional hosting or ECS for containerized workloads. You will configure environments, deploy from Visual Studio and CLI, use Auto Scaling, and monitor application health.
whatYouLearn: Explain Elastic Beanstalk and ECS for ASP.NET Core
Deploy an ASP.NET Core app with Elastic Beanstalk
Run containerized ASP.NET Core on ECS Fargate
Monitor apps with CloudWatch and health dashboards
